name: school_analytics
summary: Decision-grade KPIs, point-in-time snapshots, role dashboards and threshold alert rules for enrollment, attendance, academic performance and teacher workload
description: Implements the analytics and dashboards module from the blueprint. A school.analytics.kpi defines a metric and how it is computed: an aggregation (count, average, sum or rate) performed generically over a source model addressed by name, so enrollment, attendance, exam and workload records are measured through the ORM registry without this module importing the modules it observes. Each refresh writes a school.analytics.snapshot — a point-in-time value with its numerator, denominator and optional academic-year and campus scope — that projects a formatted display value in its KPI's unit. A school.analytics.dashboard groups tiles (school.analytics.dashboard.widget) that each bind the dashboard to a KPI with a visual style, and a school.analytics.alert rule raises when a KPI's latest snapshot crosses a threshold using a comparison operator and severity. The rate, average and sum arithmetic, the trend and gauge-band classification, the threshold comparison and the numerator in-list parsing are server-validated and unit-tested; a daily cron recomputes every active KPI and re-evaluates the alert rules, and manual actions refresh an individual KPI, snapshot or dashboard on demand. The module reuses the academic-year and campus records for snapshot scope. Navigated under the single School app.
author: Nexa
